transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. It's nice to meet you too. Um, I guess I'm here because things have been getting really difficult at work lately. I'm a waitress, and I've been doing some things that kind of scared everyone there. 

I started just... freezing up right in the middle of service. Or I'll do things completely out of order. Like, the other day, I was just standing by the soda station holding the cash drawer key, and I just kept repeating table numbers out loud instead of actually closing out my checks. It's just really affecting my job, so my manager and I figured I needed to come in.
Have there been times when your mood felt unusually high, energized, or irritable?

No, um... not really. I haven't noticed my mood being like that. I don't really get super energized or unusually happy or anything. My mood has been pretty steady, I think. It's really just... the freezing up and the confusion that's been the issue.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

Um, yeah, actually... I have. Sometimes, especially when I'm closing up the restaurant or when I'm just at home in my kitchen, I'll hear this woman's voice. She'll just say my name out loud, or she'll tell me that I'm doing the cash count wrong. It's... it's so clear that I actually answer her back before I realize that there's no one else there and nobody else heard it.
Do you believe someone is trying to harm you or control you?

Um, well, I don't know about controlling me, but... I do feel like some people are trying to get me fired. It's mostly a couple of the other servers, and there's this one regular customer too. 

I just... I keep noticing that they're watching me really closely, especially when I'm ringing things into the computer. And I keep finding these little signs on the order tickets, like they're leaving proof or trying to set me up so management will let me go. I've tried showing the tickets to my husband, but he just tells me it's normal restaurant mistakes or just messy handwriting. But it just feels so obvious to me that they're doing it on purpose.
Did these problems start very suddenly?

No, not suddenly. Um... it's actually been building up for a while now. I'd say it's been about a year and two months. That's right around the time they asked me to take on the evening shift lead responsibilities at work, and... yeah, this whole change in me just kind of started building from there.
Have you ever had a head injury, seizure, or other neurological illness?
Um, no. I haven't had any head injuries or anything like that. No seizures or... or any other brain illnesses that I know of. My physical health has always been pretty normal, honestly.
When you freeze up or do things out of order at work, do you later have gaps in your memory for what happened during those moments?

Um, no, I don't think so. I remember what happens, it's just... I get kind of stuck, or I get confused about what I'm supposed to be doing next. But I don't forget being there or anything. I remember the whole thing, it's just really overwhelming in the moment.
Have you found yourself losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to do a lot of things, but I don't really go for beach walks, bake, garden, or write in my journal much anymore. And... even when my husband tries to talk with me, I mostly just sit there. It just feels like I can't get myself to care, or even start anything.
Has anyone told you that your speech has become hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?

Um, no, not really. I mean, my husband hasn't said anything like that, and nobody at work has mentioned it either. I think I talk pretty much the same as I always have. Sometimes I might trail off if I get distracted, but no one's told me I'm hard to understand or jumping around.
Do these episodes tend to happen right after you feel stressed or overwhelmed?

Um, I'm not really sure. I haven't noticed a specific pattern like that. Sometimes work is stressful, but the feeling of getting stuck or overwhelmed just kind of happens. I don't know if one causes the other.
When you hear that woman's voice, does it seem like it's coming from outside you, as if someone is actually there speaking?

Yeah, it really does. It sounds like someone is standing right there in the room with me. Sometimes when I'm closing up at work, or... or when I'm just home in the kitchen, I'll hear this woman's voice. She'll say my name, or tell me I'm doing the cash count wrong. It's so clear that I actually answer her out loud before I even realize that nobody else is there, and nobody else heard it.
Does that woman's voice feel like your own thoughts, or like someone else's voice speaking out loud?

No, it definitely doesn't feel like my own thoughts. Like I said, it sounds exactly like someone else's voice speaking out loud. It's a woman's voice, and it's just... so clear. When I'm closing up the restaurant or just standing in my kitchen at home, she'll just speak up. She says my name, or she'll tell me I'm messing up the cash drawer count. It's so real that I'll actually talk back to her before it hits me that I'm alone in the room and no one else is hearing it.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being controlled or put into your mind by someone else?
No, I haven't ever felt anything like that. My thoughts are my own. It's just the voice that I hear from the outside, but nobody is putting thoughts into my head or controlling what I think.
Did these experiences begin after you started using any drugs or after starting a new medication?
No, I don't use drugs. And I'm not taking any medications right now. So, no, it didn't start after anything like that. It just kind of started happening on its own.
Have you noticed your memory getting worse?
No, I haven't really noticed any issues with my memory. I mean, I can still remember orders at work and everything. It's just the voice that's been bothering me. My memory seems fine.
Outside of work, have you been having trouble managing everyday tasks at home that used to be easy for you?

Yeah, things at home have been... well, my husband says I’m barely present with him anymore. I'm just not keeping up with things the way I used to. And honestly, it's affecting work, too. I know I said I can remember orders, but I'm actually close to losing a shift-lead opportunity right now. I've been making mistakes and getting confused, and it's been disrupting service and our closing duties.
Have you been seeing things that other people can’t see?
No, I haven't seen anything like that. It's really just... just the voice I mentioned before. But no, I don't see anything that isn't actually there.
